mission: Slow down only the big kill, about halfway through, to half speed or slower so nobody misses it, then export. The rest of the clip should keep normal speed.

checkpoints.describe: A slow-motion section is on the clip

checkpoints.check: state.effects.some(x => x.category === 'Speed Control' && x.speed <= 0.5 && x.start > 0 && x.duration < 0.5 * state.duration)
checkpoints.describe: It covers one moment after the start, not the whole clip

why.data: Heavy editors adjust timing on one moment and check the rest is untouched; speed control is a Premium effect in the real editor.
